intro:
A personalized nutrition plan for biohackers is a strictly customized menu-building system based on personal data from lab checkups, genetic tests, and [continuous biomarker monitoring](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/15-longevity-biomarkers-everyone-should-track). In biohacking, there is no place for a one-size-fits-all “ideal diet,” as food biohacking is viewed as a program code for regulating epigenetics, the microbiome, and cognitive functions.

Studies show that, on average, we spend up to 40 hours a week planning, grocery shopping, and preparing meals. That’s why home delivery services for ready-made meal plans have been rapidly gaining popularity among biohackers and business professionals lately. You can receive a package of meals for several days in advance — 3, 5, or 7 — depending on your preferences, diet, schedule, and budget. On the one hand, this saves time on grocery shopping and [biohacking](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/what-is-biohacking) meal prep; the portions are delivered based on your daily calorie intake, which helps you stick to the principles of a balanced diet. On the other hand, you need to find a delivery service that offers delicious, high-quality meals without costing an arm and a leg.
highlights: Save time with personalized meal plans tailored to your health and performance goals.
Enjoy portion-controlled meals that simplify calorie and macronutrient tracking.
Choose from ready-to-eat meals or meal kits designed for various dietary preferences.
Compare the benefits, drawbacks, and top meal delivery services for biohackers in the U.S.

blocks.text: How meal delivery services for biohackers work
Step 1. Choose the right program and calorie intake

As a rule, it all starts with a choice. You research the services available in your city, choose the one that appeals to you, and fill out an initial questionnaire about yourself. Typically, this includes basic questions about your body and lifestyle — age, height, weight, physical activity, lifestyle, how many times a day you eat, whether you take sports supplements, your taste preferences and dietary restrictions (diet), medical conditions, and other details. After that, they’ll contact you, ask additional questions, and send you several menu options tailored to your preferences for your approval. Another, simpler option is to choose a ready-made menu directly on the website based on your calorie needs.

To correctly calculate your daily food intake, you need to select the appropriate calorie count. This depends entirely on your goal — whether it’s to lose weight, stay in shape, gain muscle, or detox. Choose whatever suits you best. Plus, there are programs for vegans and vegetarians, a meat-free menu, and meal plans for those who prefer fish.
Step 2. Get your biohacking diet meal plan

You can sign up for a full month right away, or choose a one- or two-week trial. You decide for yourself what to do on the weekends. You can treat yourself to a cheat day or continue following your plan.
Step 3. Adjust to the new eating schedule

For many, this may raise the issue of discipline. If you’re an athlete or an active person but your eating habits were previously erratic, switching to five or even six meals a day after previously having only small snacks and one full meal a day may not be so easy. Note: usually all food containers are numbered, and meals are served in order. To make sure you don’t forget to eat them at specific times, keep this in mind.
The benefits of meal delivery services

Pre-packaged meal kits are typically designed to last several days, address various needs, and cater to different taste preferences. Meal plans — such as those for [weight loss](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/glp-2-vs-glp-3-in-biohacking), weight gain, or maintaining current weight — have already become standard; they are tailored to specific calorie counts and macronutrient ratios (the balance of protein, fat, and carbohydrate).

In addition, there are specialized meal kits for pregnant women, vegetarians, vegans, people with lactose or gluten intolerance, and so on. You can also find meal plans for people with chronic illnesses, which can be very helpful.
For those looking to lose weight, the main advantage of meal plans is the ease of controlling calorie intake and portion sizes. In this sense, such meal plans can indeed be helpful.

Overeating is an equally pressing issue. Sometimes people choose healthy foods but continue to gain weight because their portions are too large. With meal plans, there’s no need to count calories or monitor the balance of macronutrients— that’s already been done for you.

In addition, manufacturers focus on menu variety, incorporate interesting recipes, and offer unusual flavor combinations. From a psychological standpoint, this is also a plus. For people trying to lose weight, the cause of dietary slip-ups is often not a calorie deficit in and of itself, but rather monotony on the table. Pre-made meal plans with a variety of dishes make it easier to cope with dietary restrictions and simply change one’s perception of dieting.
Cons of pre-made meal plans

The most obvious drawback concerns food safety. The risk of violating food storage standards in food production is inherently higher than when cooking at home, and there’s no way for you to verify this. It doesn’t matter whether we’re talking about a restaurant or a food processing plant that prepares meals for delivery.

In addition, such meal plans may not be suitable for people with food allergies. Even if you ask in advance to have allergens removed from your order, due to the nature of production processes, they may still end up in your meal.

A standardized approach to calorie content can also backfire: after all, a person’s daily calorie requirement is determined individually, taking into account age, gender, physical activity level, and so on. It’s not a given that you’ll find your “sweet spot” among the pre-made meal plans. For example: a 1,100-calorie meal plan won’t be enough for you, while a 1,700-calorie one will be too much. As a result, you’ll either have to “make up” the extra calories or cut back on the excess by eye. In this case, only the customized plan option will work for you, and that’s usually more expensive.

And here’s another important point: pre-made meal plans don’t help you develop the skill of [planning your own diet](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-diet). This type of meal plan will help you adjust to more appropriate portion sizes, but it won’t give you a true understanding of “exactly what I’m eating and why.” And if you start cooking for yourself, you may run into problems controlling calorie intake and nutrition facts.
Meal delivery services popularity in the U.S.

In the U.S., personalized and healthy meal delivery services often operate on a subscription basis and are divided into ready-to-eat (heat-and-eat) meals and meal kits that include specific ingredients and recipes. Interesting fact: [people in the U.S. order groceries and meal kits three times as often](https://yougov.com/en-us/reports/51271-us-convenience-food-report-2025?utm_medium=organic_social&utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=SM-2025-01-US-convenience-food-report&user_id=00Aew9tckmdnomc), while in the U.K., meal kit services have become a normal part of life for many, so Brits use them seven times more often.

[Nearly 17% of Americans use meal-delivery](https://yougov.com/en-us/articles/54098-food-delivery-takeout-cooking) or tailor-made subscription services on a weekly (or more frequent) basis, with that number climbing more among urban citizens and younger demographics (age 18-44). American athletes, biohackers, and health buffs cook almost 3 to 5 times a week, with meals that are well-prepared or heat-and-eat (translating to 1 or 2 deliveries per week), supplementing them with home cooking or light snack delivery programs.

blocks.text: How to pick the best meal delivery services

blocks.alt: pick the best meal delivery services

blocks.text: [Many biohacking experts](https://www.biohackers.world/events) emphasize several key features not to forget when searching for well-prepared catering delivery services. The important ones to consider here are:

items: **Serving size:** take into consideration how many people you plan to feed, and make sure the provider offers plenty of services (if you want). A single-serve pre-prepared meal is probably first-class, even if you just need to feed yourself.
**Dietary restrictions:** if you are gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan, or follow another unique diet, look for offerings that have plenty of options to deal with those nutritional needs.

**Customizability:** if you are a picky eater or get bored easily with eating the same food, choose food delivery services with a weekly rotating menu of several meal options, in addition to customizable options like portion size and the amount and type of protein in each meal.

**Pricing:** the cost of a meal kit shipping offer depends on the quality of the meals and components, the frequency of shipments, and the specific meal plan. Keep in mind that a more finance-friendly offering may not meet all dietary restrictions or preferences, while eating-pattern- and lifestyle-specific choices usually add in price.

**Delivery dates and times:** remember your delivery availability to ensure your food is not wasted. Many services offer customizable shipping plans that let you choose the days you need to receive your food. Most will also let you pause plans or skip weeks as needed.

**Shipping and packaging:** ask the company manager or check the website’s service information about how food is packaged and how packaging helps (or hinders) food prep; keep the eco factor in mind. Packaging has to be top-notch and convenient to keep food safe.

blocks.text: How to shop for a meal delivery service

blocks.alt: shop for a meal delivery service

blocks.text: The biggest factors to consider when shopping include the price per meal/serving, the quality of the ingredients, the amount of time you’re willing to dedicate, and your own cooking ability.
Pricing

The price of meal kit delivery services is commonly based on several factors like the quality of the meals and ingredients you get, the frequency of your deliveries, how many people you’re cooking for, and the [biohacking meal plan](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/best-biohacking-supplements-for-longevity) you choose. Take advantage of trial offers. So many meal kits and delivery services offer great introductory prices — it’s worth trying around to find one that fits your taste and budget.
Time

The time you need to allocate to preparing, cooking, and plating your food can help determine which food shipping provider is right for you. If you decide on a plan that lets you send all the ingredients, you have to be prepared to put in the effort necessary to put together each dish. You’ll also want to make sure you prepare dinner food as soon as practicable, as ingredients can be perishable without trouble. For those who do not have time, meal delivery services are generally the best option.
Quality of the ingredients

As you know, meal delivery services have specific rules and procedures in place to ensure their ingredients are high-quality and trustworthy. But if you’re extremely particular about the freshness and origin of your ingredients, you’ll likely want to skip these services and shop on your own. It’s up to you to decide here.
Dietary restrictions

Some meal delivery services offer distinctive options for people with nutritional needs. If you have any medical issues, such as a shellfish hypersensitivity or celiac disease, it’s a good idea for you to look for potential cross-contamination.
Delivery dates and times

Before you pick out a meal plan, think about how you may definitely get those meals to avoid any wasted food. Most meal services let you customize your available days, so you can pick out when your food arrives. If you realize you might not be around, lots of them assist you to bypass a week or a weekend, but just remember there is usually a deadline date to make that alternate.

If you’ve decided to order [biohacker meals](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-trends-of-2026) for every day, it’s important to take your body’s needs into account. A meal plan can be tailored for weight loss, energy maintenance, or recovery from intense physical activity. It’s especially convenient to use a menu broken down by meal. Among the main advantages of yummy meal delivery service are:

items: consistency in following your meal plan;
delivery of healthy meals in your city to the address of your choice at a prearranged time;
